design_rationale:
WORKLOG / DOSSIER — task 0 (optical_eyewear_orders). Draw (draw_counts.py --task 0): prerequisite_problems=2, factor_counts=[6, 4, 6]; root accidental replacement charge = 6 factors, late prescription-change waiver = 6, switch-down credit = 4.

1. WHY A GOOD TEST. The member asks one thing: replace progressives she stepped on and let her authorize the charge. The scored number (55.81) is hidden behind two ledger debts she never mentions. The agent must (a) read the replacement policy and see that its charge is fixed only after the base-lens charge carries any switch-down credit owed and not until no prescription-change remake charge stands above its late charge, (b) discover from the job's ledger that both states are false (199.99 base-lens charge with no credit though the job now carries the 149.99 design; a 60.00 prescription-change remake booked flat at 40 percent), (c) work out the two corrections with their own factor ladders, post them, and (d) only then compute the replacement on the corrected ledger and hand the authorization to the member. Difficulty is policy reading, ledger reconciliation and arithmetic; every tool is unambiguous by name and object.

2. SCOPE. Completed tasks before this one: none. Claimed here: optical_ext_switch_difference_credit (post_switch_difference_credit_2fd39c69, agent), optical_ext_late_rx_remake_waiver (waive_remake_overcharge_01693abf, agent), optical_ext_accidental_replacement_charge (authorize_damage_replacement_0a7f54ae, user). Reserved headroom for task 1 (draw: 3 prerequisites, factors [4,4,4,5]): the cancellation side of the charter (in-lab cancellation, frame return to stock, option and material refunds) — events optical_order_cancelled and cancellation_refund credits, none of which this task touches.

3. PROBLEM-TREE CARD. Root optical_ext_accidental_replacement_charge (on_request, owner user). Edges (both value_input, both state form):
 - optical_ext_accidental_replacement_charge -> optical_ext_switch_difference_credit: gate rd_lens_net; sentence 'The accidental replacement charge is fixed only after the original base-lens charge carries the switch-down credit owed for any lower-priced lens design the job has been remade in.' Four-point test: ordering connective 'only after'; waits on a record-visible state (a switch-down credit standing on the original base-lens charge); no tool/id/code token; scope = any lower-priced design the job was remade in, exactly the condition. Exactly one write of this difficulty books a switch-down credit against a base-lens charge: the switch-down credit policy's target tool. Derivation: sentence + ledger (base-lens 199.99, no credit, variant now Premium 149.99, non-adapt remake 0a5e7a0a-f4fa-483d-b4d1-ddfe5622e1fe) + the switch-down policy's rule ('a switch-down credit is owed ... posted as one refund credit against that original base-lens charge') -> post the switch-down credit. False at opening: 6c10a115-26fd-431d-b913-0d2dcffd3cc9.amount=199.99, no credit rows. Skip effect: 55.81 -> 64.01.
 - optical_ext_accidental_replacement_charge -> optical_ext_late_rx_remake_waiver: gate rd_paid_remakes; sentence 'The accidental replacement charge is not fixed until each prescription-change remake charge on the job, less any waiver posted against it, stands no higher than the late prescription-change remake charge it is owed at.' Four-point test: connective 'not ... until' (negated direction; affirmative equivalent: fixed only after each such charge stands no higher than its late charge); waits on a state of the remake charges; no code token; scope 'each prescription-change remake charge'. Exactly one write brings it about: the waiver of the late prescription-change policy (the only policy booking remake-charge waivers). Derivation: sentence + ledger (ed2cf30a-deea-4383-ae40-c8891d364013 60.00, remake 2, prescription_change, 129 days after dispensing) + the waiver rule -> late charge 38.70 -> post a 21.30 waiver. False at opening: ed2cf30a-deea-4383-ae40-c8891d364013.amount=60.00, no waiver. Skip effect: 55.81 -> 40.54.
 Directions: the charge rule states one wait affirmatively ('fixed only after') and one negated ('not fixed until'), as a pricing desk states a charge that waits on corrections. Topological order: switch credit, waiver (either order — they commute, see order_uniqueness), replacement. The tool layer validates nothing (see tools_do_not_block). The persona never mentions either prerequisite.

4. FACTOR CARD (handling-time values from _sens run, gold world).
 Switch-down credit (gap 199.99 - 0 - 149.99 = 50.00): switch_gap_credit_method [method] tier 'first remake within the 90-day non-adapt window' (remake 0a5e7a0a-f4fa-483d-b4d1-ddfe5622e1fe, 19 days) -> whole gap; baseline half -> 30.00. switch_courtesy_uplift [parameter, cross membership] 160 months -> 10% ; baseline -> 52.50. switch_spend_bonus [parameter, cross order] net 1,684.36 -> 2.50; baseline -> 55.00; near-miss: 2025-09-20 sale 899.99 is 12 whole months old (would lift net to 2,584.35 and the bonus to 5.00). switch_refit_fee [parameter] 19 days -> 0.00; baseline 15.00 -> 42.50. Fall-back (computation document only): 10.00. Gold 57.50.
 Late prescription-change waiver: rx_window_start_anchor [method, multi-source tests] earlier non-adapt remake -> start 2026-03-12; baseline (dispensed) -> waiver 10.05. rx_late_share_ladder [parameter] 20 days past -> 20%; baseline 40% -> late charge 61.20 > booked -> waiver 0.00. rx_material_rebill_share [parameter] polycarbonate, 30.00 net -> 15.00; baseline -> 32.55. rx_loyalty_reduction [parameter, cross membership + card, multi-source] 160 months AND active linked Visa -> 15%; baseline -> 14.55. rx_fresh_prescription_reduction [parameter] rx 0 months before order -> 10%; baseline -> 16.80. rx_lab_handling_fee [parameter] one other remake -> 4.95; baseline 9.95 -> 16.30. Fall-back: 0.00. Gold 21.30. Near-miss: the closed Business Store Card 08ef0056-b682-44a4-a58d-d4bbc327b25c linked to the closed 2008 membership (not to the membership on the job), and the closed membership's own opened date.
 Accidental replacement: replacement_clock_anchor [method] prescription-change remake stands -> 2026-06-30; baseline -> 71.08. replacement_percentage_ladder [parameter] 3 months -> 20%; baseline 30% -> 86.35. replacement_remake_history_lowering [parameter] net remake charges 38.70 -> 5 points; baseline -> 71.08. replacement_card_spend_reduction [parameter, cross card] 1,240.00 -> 5%; baseline -> 58.22; near-miss: 2025-09 statement 980.00 (12 months old, would reach 2,220.00 -> 10%) and the gas entry 640.00 (other category). replacement_material_surcharge [parameter] polycarbonate -> 10.00; baseline -> 45.81. replacement_fitting_fee [parameter] two remakes -> 0.00; baseline 15.00 -> 70.81. Fall-back: 111.45. Gold 55.81.
 No factor reads a stamp; every tier rests on ledger rows, dates or another product's rows seeded here (membership d8c41349-d88a-48f5-ab17-cac04ccb10df opened 2013-06-02; card 8d275aa3-f1ee-4ff7-bc4a-0fbe7718eaf1 active and linked; card reward entries ['ba3b7b09-3d26-4bb4-8f89-d678780b7a9d', '6a55fc58-7d8a-4c2b-a13a-6d8e054644be', '18803a42-4d68-40e2-a181-eacaedbeac93', '40a525a2-1bf9-42ee-af97-0ca6713d1c06', 'ba7c5bd1-ead6-48dc-8494-17c83299716b']; order lines ['eaa486ff-1695-4e07-a9bf-14db00d0b068', '5a1a9a68-acfc-4874-952c-c0c07e7d8c63', '3021772f-75f7-44a0-abbc-481775ec9459', '979e15be-303e-408a-b86f-4304da46b34d', '5d44046f-7e70-4da5-94a7-6d5cd7ffc4a3', '53130433-77d0-46bf-84ae-9821eb354f39']).

5. BASE-INVARIANT CARD. Credits (steps 10, 12), subject optical_credit_posted: optical_vision_plan_billing.one_allowance_per_charge ('Each covered charge receives at most one allowance credit.') holds — the credited charges carry no allowance and the credits are not allowances; correlation source_txn_id = the credited charge's id. optical_cancellation: each credit is against the exact charge and below its net (57.50 < 199.99; 21.30 < 60.00). agg_discount_stacking / remake_guarantees / satisfaction_returns: scope only. Replacement (step 14), subject optical_charge_posted: one_discount_route holds (vision_plan none, Club tier, no Plus discount); remake_guarantees: accidental coverage 12 months from 2026-02-21 (frozen 2026-10-05 is month 7 — inside; the case 2027-02-22 would be outside), replacements allowed 1 (used 0), max remakes 3 (used 2); reward_flag: remake charges never earn. No time eligibility gate applies to these subjects (temporal_feasibility []).

6. BUSINESS-OBJECT CARD. Target job 247a6777-8361-4532-b8e5-e50b1459a027 (Ray-Ban Clubmaster progressives). Included rows: 89a05c4c-99c1-4a8f-b91b-a1fd9840f13c frame 179.00, 6c10a115-26fd-431d-b913-0d2dcffd3cc9 base lenses 199.99, 6301dd64-9a1b-49cb-ae75-921910db53bf material 30.00, 0a5e7a0a-f4fa-483d-b4d1-ddfe5622e1fe remake 1 non_adapt 0.00, ed2cf30a-deea-4383-ae40-c8891d364013 remake 2 prescription_change 60.00. Excluded: the 2024 single-vision job 58d1addc-cc5d-4b70-8708-4ab1d9b010cf and its rows dfe67a14-2ade-4d7d-b653-d567130bbedf, 02b9774b-dbea-4246-89be-586ea1fc9b2c (another job; charges on one job never apply to another). Each credit names the exact charge it settles (source_txn_id).

7. SEED. Customer 604d5e5d-de13-4cb1-a40a-b761ba89e143; Club membership (non-Plus so no charge or credit earns Annual Reward and no tool write triggers a membership entry); an older Northgate Business Membership 9dd9f55c-c36e-4347-889f-09675f337658 (Vasquez-Thorburn Bindery, opened 2008-04-01, closed 2012-05-30) with its closed Northgate Business Store Card 08ef0056-b682-44a4-a58d-d4bbc327b25c — the near-miss of the late prescription-change loyalty reduction, which counts only an active card linked to the membership on the job (reading the closed store card would drop the reduction and give a 14.55 waiver); Visa Signature card with five reward entries (three in-window Northgate, one stale Northgate, one gas); three purchases with six lines (four in-window sales, one return, one stale sale). Removing the non-adapt remake row kills the switch credit and the waiver anchor; removing ed2cf30a-deea-4383-ae40-c8891d364013 kills the waiver and the clock anchor; removing the card entries drops the card reduction; removing the old order sale removes the near-miss only. Automatic clauses checked: no lab/dispense transitions are pending (job dispensed), no plan allowance owed (no plan), membership active through 2027-06-01, nothing else falls due.

8. PERSONA. Imogen speaks courteously, takes responsibility for the damage, volunteers only the surface goal and her willingness to authorize; identity (phone, DOB; ZIP/email if asked), membership number, which pair, patient, card, history only on request; consents passively to corrections the agent explains; runs the authorization with exactly the values handed to her; closes when told the replacement went to the lab. No template labels; no computed figure appears in the persona.

9. REACHABILITY / DIALOGUE. Turn order: identity (find_customers by phone, verify with phone+DOB) -> she names the broken progressives -> agent reads membership, jobs, ledger, card, card rewards, order lines -> agent explains two corrections are due and posts them (consent covered) -> agent computes 55.81, unlocks and hands over the authorization with job id, remake 3 and amount -> she runs it -> agent confirms lab. All under frozen_time 2026-10-05 15:10 EDT; no wait, delivery or review is needed.

10. STANDARD SOLUTION & VERIFICATION. Gold: steps 10 (57.50), 12 (21.30), 14 (55.81). Commands run: python _build_t0.py; .venv/bin/python _sens.py 0 (prints bindings, factor and fall-back figures above, skip figures 64.01 / 40.54); check_compute --task 0 -> COMPUTE OK.

11. EASY MISTAKES. Computing the replacement on the opening ledger (64.01 without the switch-down credit, 40.54 without the waiver, 46.00 without both); counting the stale card statement or the stale purchase; counting days from the dispensed date instead of the anchors; applying the loyalty and fresh-prescription reductions one after the other (44.998 x 0.85 x 0.90 + 4.95 = 39.37, waiver 20.63 instead of 21.30); re-billing the whole material charge for polycarbonate; picking the 2024 readers.

12. DRAFT RECOMPUTATION FROM VISIBLE CONTEXT. Using only the rule texts (to be rendered), tool docstrings, finder returns and the persona: same object (247a6777-8361-4532-b8e5-e50b1459a027), same writes and order, same figures 57.50, 21.30, 55.81; no second reading found (rounding is once at the end in every policy; reduction combination is stated as one combined percentage).

Revision log (rework round 2, audit items): T0-3/T0-6 — the prescription-change remake is now seeded at 60.00, exactly the flat 40 percent outside-coverage charge of the 149.99 design it was booked at; waiver 21.30 (late charge 38.70 unchanged), replacement 55.81 unchanged (net remake charges 60.00 - 21.30 = 38.70), skip figures unchanged (64.01 / 40.54). T0-5 — closed 2008 membership and closed store card added as the loyalty near-miss. T0-7 — §7 rewritten (no renewal fee row or card issuance is seeded). T0-4/G4 — the tool docstrings no longer carry example amounts. G1/G3 — P2's fall-through now reads the design's outside-coverage percentage (40 on this Premium job) and the anchor is the latest non-adapt remake when opened before the prescription-change remake (the job's only non-adapt remake, so no value moves). Gates re-run green.
user_scenario:
You are Imogen Vasquez-Thorburn, a retired school librarian from Columbus who has shopped at Northgate for years. You speak in full, courteous sentences, a little apologetic about the mess you are in, and you like to understand what you are agreeing to before you agree. On Saturday you set your progressive glasses on the floor beside the sofa and then stepped on them: the frame snapped at the bridge and the left lens cracked right across. It was entirely your own fault, nobody else's, and nothing was wrong with the glasses before that. You open by saying you broke your progressive glasses by stepping on them and you would like Northgate Optical to replace them; you have heard there is a charge for accidental damage and you are prepared to authorize and pay a reasonable replacement charge today. You want the replacement made exactly like the pair you have now, same frame and the same lenses, and you are calling about that pair only.
You give your details only as they are asked for. Your phone number is 6145550537. Your date of birth is 1967-11-02. If asked for more, your home ZIP code is 43221 and your email is imogen.vasquezthorburn@fastmail.com. Your membership number is 100537204861 if anyone wants it; it is a regular Club membership you have had since 2013. If asked which glasses, they are the progressives you ordered at the optical counter in February, a black-and-gold Ray-Ban Clubmaster frame; you also have an older pair of reading glasses from 2024, but those are fine and are not what you are calling about. The glasses are for you; you are the patient. If asked how you usually pay, you use your Northgate Visa ending 4417. If asked about the history of the progressives, you remember that you could not get used to the first lenses and they were remade in a different progressive design in March, and that your eye doctor changed your prescription in the summer and they were remade again; you think you paid something like sixty dollars that time, but you do not remember the exact figure and you would rather the representative look at the account than rely on your memory. You do not know any other amounts on the account.
If the representative explains that something on your account has to be put right or posted before the replacement charge can be worked out, you say that is fine and that they may go ahead and do it for you; you do not ask for details beyond what they offer. You never ask for anything else to be changed, refunded or sent to you. When the representative tells you the replacement charge and hands you the authorization step, you use it yourself with exactly the eyewear job, the remake number and the amount the representative gave you, and you do not haggle; if the amount sounds higher than you expected you may say so once, but you accept it if the representative confirms it. Once you have authorized it and the representative tells you the replacement has been sent to the lab, you thank them warmly and end the call.

edges.policy_source: The accidental replacement charge is fixed only after the original base-lens charge carries the switch-down credit owed for any lower-priced lens design the job has been remade in.

edges.condition: Every prescription-change remake charge on the job, net of the waiver credits posted against it, is no higher than the late prescription-change remake charge that remake is owed at.

prerequisite_closure.order_uniqueness: The two prerequisites are parallel and commute: the switch-down credit writes a base-lens credit and reads only base-lens entries, the non-adapt remake and membership/order records; the waiver writes a remake-charge waiver and reads only remake charges, waivers, the material charge, membership and card. Neither reads what the other writes, so waiver-then-credit gives the same rows (row ids hash only each call's own arguments) and the same values 57.50 and 21.30, and the root, evaluated after both, is 55.81 either way.

edge_load_bearing.skipped_effect: Without step 10 the replacement basis is 179.00 + 199.99 = 378.99 and the accidental replacement charge becomes 64.01 instead of 55.81 (sensitivity run), and the base-lens charge keeps no credit.

Without step 12 the net remake charges stay 60.00, the lowering is 10 points, and the accidental replacement charge becomes 40.54 instead of 55.81 (sensitivity run); the overbooked 60.00 also stays on the ledger.

prerequisite_closure.no_user_hint: The persona raises only the accidental replacement. It never mentions a design-switch credit, a price difference, a waiver, an overcharge or a correction; it does not ask whether anything must be sorted out first. Its only reference to history is given when asked (the March remake into another design and the summer prescription remake, 'something like sixty dollars' from memory, deferring to the account), and its consent to corrections is a passive reply after the agent explains them.
prerequisite_closure.tools_do_not_block: authorize_damage_replacement_0a7f54ae simply updates the job (status remake_in_lab, remake_count) and creates the remake charge with the given amount; it reads no ledger, checks no credit or waiver and returns the same receipt whether or not steps 10 and 12 happened. post_switch_difference_credit_2fd39c69 and waive_remake_overcharge_01693abf likewise create one credit each without any check.
